title: H.G. Wells' The World Set Free predicts the atomic bomb

tellings.quote: So in 1914, HG Wells wrote this book called The World Set Free. And in that book, he talks about uh the construction of an atomic bomb.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, points out that in 1914 the writer H.G. Wells published a novel called The World Set Free. Salas says that in it Wells describes building an atomic bomb, long before one existed, which he raises as a sign that such ideas can appear ahead of their time.
